decision: Exact reviewed predicate reorder; no actionable source-level issue. Stage2 runtime correctness and performance remain pending.
stage1_evidence_scope: Prior stage1 results are not claimed as stage2 execution results.

equivalence.order: Both visit ALL in its original order. Every eligible commodity executes the same refusal, flow, flag and reach statements in that order.
equivalence.side_effects: Both operands are pure reads. A false mask entry skips only immutable tracked-table access. No world arithmetic, mutation, RNG, priority, serialization, fixture or assertion is changed.
equivalence.empty_mask: The accepted stage1 early return is byte-identical.
equivalence.untracked_case_caution: TRACKED currently equals all twelve COMMODITIES and the loader enforces it. Thus the false-tracked truth-table rows are analytic parity, not claimed live-fixture coverage. A future withdrawn commodity remains excluded even if supplied a true stall entry.
equivalence.cold_table_caution: As in stage1, no parity claim is made for panic timing of invalid embedded data; valid initialized game tables are assumed.
